entities.name: EPS update type
entities.description: Specifies the area the updating procedure is associated with and indicates whether bearer establishment is requested.

entities.name: EPS update type IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier for EPS update type, located in bits 8-5 of octet 1.

entities.name: Active flag
entities.description: Indicates whether bearer establishment is requested (1) or not (0). Located in bit 4 of octet 1.

entities.name: EPS update type Value
entities.description: Encodes the type of update procedure: TA updating, combined TA/LA updating, combined TA/LA updating with IMSI attach, periodic updating, or unused values interpreted as TA updating.

entities.name: TA updating
entities.description: Update procedure associated with Tracking Area.

entities.name: combined TA/LA updating
entities.description: Update procedure associated with both Tracking Area and Location Area.

entities.name: combined TA/LA updating with IMSI attach
entities.description: Update procedure for combined TA/LA updating with IMSI attach.

entities.name: No bearer establishment requested
entities.description: Condition when Active flag is 0, indicating no bearer establishment is requested.

entities.name: Bearer establishment requested
entities.description: Condition when Active flag is 1, indicating bearer establishment is requested.

relations.description: The EPS update type IE contains the IEI identifier.
The EPS update type IE contains the Active flag field.
The EPS update type IE contains the EPS update type value field.
The EPS update type value field is guarded by the TA updating condition when bits 3-1 are 000.
The EPS update type value field is guarded by the combined TA/LA updating condition when bits 3-1 are 001.
The EPS update type value field is guarded by the combined TA/LA updating with IMSI attach condition when bits 3-1 are 010.
The EPS update type value field is guarded by the periodic updating condition when bits 3-1 are 011.
The Active flag field is guarded by the no bearer establishment condition when bit 4 is 0.
The Active flag field is guarded by the bearer establishment requested condition when bit 4 is 1.
